player_prompt.intro:
Am ̣Player {player_id} Checkers kheḷeḍa {color} hisab se kheḷaṭaṃ.
Chess taṛe notation me move koro [fileRank fileRank], jaise '[b2c3]' (column akshar a–h, saf digit 0–7).
Ṃuḷ niyam:
  • Khali thaye to diagonal aage 1 kadam jao.
  • Birodhi piece ke upar se jump karo.
  • Piece ulta sesh pahuṇc̣ele te King hoye jaye.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱢᱩᱵ ᱞᱮᱠᱟᱛ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ. ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ [a1b2], ᱩᱫᱟᱦᱚᱨᱚᱱ ᱞᱮᱠᱟ [b2c3].
